info.title: RAIT Worklist commands
info.description: P4-02-S1 typed scoped replacement of the frozen107-method baseline. ADR0046/47 and T0 closed access/triage maps govern complete role purposes; runtime production qualification is separate. No claim-context/risk API or selector change. P4-02-S2 current risk is consumed through the public CASE read-only snapshot provider; existing stored clock reads remain historical metadata, no new WORKLIST endpoint or flag mutation.

200.description: Escala criada

post.x-rait-scope: T0 complete action+role+purpose; source and target parent checks and actor-bound replay; no role/permission/admin bypass. Existing legal transitions, version guards and response contract remain unchanged.

x-rait-scope.purposeSelection: server-owned complete role/action/purpose union; never cross-role scope mixing
x-rait-scope.parent: source AND target parents including all related references
x-rait-scope.sql: tenant and complete scope before sorting/count/pagination; no generic500-row authorization

200.description: Authorized purpose-projected result; collections retain bare array shape and contain only scoped rows.
